faq.title: Got a question? The answer's probably here

ownersItems.q: How do I book a wash?
ownersItems.a: Open the app, pick a nearby wash, choose the service, add-ons and a free slot, then confirm. You'll get a notification when the wash confirms your time.

ownersItems.q: Is the price I see the price I pay?
ownersItems.a: Yes. The price is calculated by the system before you confirm, including the service, add-ons and any available offer. Anything you add at the wash shows clearly on your receipt.
Yes, from the booking screen in the app before your slot — the wash is notified right away.

ownersItems.q: How will I know my car is ready?
ownersItems.a: The app notifies you at every stage: confirmation, check-in, washing started and the moment your car is ready.
Cash, card or online depending on what the wash supports, with a clear receipt.
Every wash is reviewed before joining the platform, and ratings come from real customers after their wash and are moderated.

partnersItems.q: How do I join WashUp as a car wash?
partnersItems.a: Submit an application, our team reviews your details, and once approved your account is activated so you can set up branches and services and start taking bookings.

partnersItems.q: Can I log customers who don't use the app?
partnersItems.a: Yes. Walk-ins and phone orders are created from the same portal and follow the same stages and reports.
A clear commission on orders that come through the app, shown alongside your revenue and payouts on the finance screen.

partnersItems.q: I have several branches. Does that work?
partnersItems.a: Yes. The owner manages every branch from one account, and each branch can have a manager with the permissions you choose.

partnersItems.q: How do I organize my team?
partnersItems.a: Add your team, set each person's permissions and weekly shifts; employees handle orders from the employee app, and you close each day with a clear reconciliation.

partnersItems.q: How will I hear about new orders?
partnersItems.a: Instant browser and mobile notifications for every new order or change, even when the portal is closed.

cta.title: Ready to see your car shine?
cta.lede: Get the app and book your next wash — or list your car wash and start taking new bookings.
